task: Resolve page arrangement, blank space voids, and print overflow on Secretary Minutes (OVPAA-F-INS-032). Ensure balanced 3-sheet distribution, eliminate phantom blank pages, prevent table-footer overlap, and achieve polished visual rhythm aligned with i-arrange.

changes.summary: Implemented buildDefault3Sheets and autoAllocateContinuationSheets to dynamically balance committee remarks across 3 authentic sheets (Sheet 1: Chair + Metadata; Sheet 2: Member 1; Sheet 3: Member 2 + Recommendations + Verdict + Signature). Fixed parent margin bleed in @media print (#root .space-y-10 > :not([hidden]) ~ :not([hidden]) { margin-top: 0 !important; }), enforced strict 297mm A4 box-sizing, added static print twins for Type of Defense, Rounds, and Verdict checkmarks, and provided a 'Balance Pages' button in the toolbar.
Expanded test suite to 15 tests covering 3-sheet default rendering, button placements, auto-distribution idempotency, capacity splitting, static print twin rendering, and removal controls.
